heading: Credit Rating

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS NON- CONVERTIBLE 459[***] SECURITIES 460[***]

content:
55. Each rating obtained by the listed entity with respect to non-convertible 524[***]
securities shall be reviewed at least once a year by a credit rating agency registered by
the Board.

footnotes.text:
524 The word “debt” omitted by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Fifth Amendment)
Regulations, 2021 w.e.f. 7.9.2021.
